duration.text: The Computer Application Technology at Anhui University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.To have received an education of Master’s degree or a similar education; 2.To submit his/her graduation certificate or similar diploma; 3.To submit his/her research topic and plan; and 2 letters of recommendation from two professors
